gaps.normative_requirement: Power input is assessed against the appliance’s rated power input.
gaps.finding_reason: The declared rating is 240 V, 400 W, but the power-input table uses a 2,500 W rated basis and records 2,580 W. The photograph also shows a label reading 380 V, three-phase, so attribution of the results to EC/27FW is not established.
gaps.required_action: Establish the identity and rating of the tested sample and replace the report with traceable results for the declared model.

gaps.normative_requirement: The measured power-input deviation is compared with the permitted deviation from rated input.
gaps.finding_reason: For 2,500 W rated and 2,580 W measured, the deviation is +3.2%, not the reported +6.7%, +7.3% or +10.0%. The three rows repeat the same powers.
gaps.required_action: Recalculate the deviations from verified measurements and record the applicable limit and representative operating period.

gaps.normative_requirement: Temperature rises during the heating test shall not exceed the applicable limits.
gaps.finding_reason: The report records an internal-wire rise of 61.9 K against its stated limit of 35 K: an objective failure. The general "not out of tolerance" statement and the N/A table verdict do not resolve it.
gaps.required_action: Investigate the failure, correct the product or demonstrate an expressly applicable different limit, and repeat the relevant assessment.

gaps.normative_requirement: The supplied standards do not specify report-date consistency or identification of appended photographs.
gaps.finding_reason: The cover dates the report 10 April 2026, before the stated test end of 17 April, while the issue page gives 17 April; the only photograph is not linked to the declared model.
gaps.required_action: Obtain an authenticated replacement report with consistent dates and traceable sample photographs.

gaps.normative_requirement: A power-input measurement applies where the appliance is marked with rated power input.
gaps.finding_reason: Clause 10.1 is marked N/A on page 11 despite the 400 W declaration and a populated table on page 77; the table uses a conflicting rated input.
gaps.required_action: Assess the 400 W model at its rated voltage and resolve the inconsistent verdict.

gaps.normative_requirement: Unless otherwise specified, tests are performed in a draught-free location at 20 °C ± 5 °C.
gaps.finding_reason: The heating table records an ambient temperature of 45 °C, outside the specified range; no applicable alternative condition is identified.
gaps.required_action: Repeat the heating assessment at the specified ambient temperature and document the conditions.

gaps.normative_requirement: Washing-machine heating tests use the specified load and water conditions and the applicable operating-cycle sequence.
gaps.finding_reason: The report does not record the textile load, initial water temperature, programme or cycle and rest-period sequence needed to establish the washing-machine test conditions.
gaps.required_action: Document the construction and repeat or substantiate the heating test using the applicable washing-machine conditions and sequence.

gaps.normative_requirement: Washing machines shall be at least IPX4, and the IP number other than IPX0 shall be marked.
gaps.finding_reason: The report passes ingress protection but gives no classification, marks IP identification N/A, and marks the IPX4 positioning provision N/A without an explanation.
gaps.required_action: Identify and verify the IP classification and marking and document the applicable IPX4 test arrangement and results.

gaps.normative_requirement: The washing-machine instructions shall specify the maximum dry-cloth mass in kilograms.
gaps.finding_reason: The report’s instructions section does not address the required maximum load; that value also determines the normal-operation test load.
gaps.required_action: Provide the instructions and record the maximum dry-cloth mass and its use in testing.

gaps.normative_requirement: Safe-use instructions, the specified supervision statements and the type Y supply-cord replacement instruction are required.
gaps.finding_reason: Type Y attachment is declared, but the report does not address its cord-replacement instruction or the general safety and child-supervision statements.
gaps.required_action: Examine the supplied instructions and document conformity with the applicable safety and type Y wording.

gaps.normative_requirement: Washing machines are tested for spillage, including the prescribed top-surface solution application and, as applicable, overflow treatment.
gaps.finding_reason: A pass is recorded against the general spillage wording, but the report gives no washing-machine-specific procedure, solution quantities, overflow conditions or post-test observations.
gaps.required_action: Perform or substantiate the particular-part spillage test and record its conditions and results.

gaps.normative_requirement: The foaming test is performed immediately after 15.2 and before the humidity test, unless the applicable electrolyser provisions replace it.
gaps.finding_reason: No foaming test or associated sequence is reported, and the appliance is not described sufficiently to establish an Annex CC alternative.
gaps.required_action: Identify whether Annex CC applies and document the applicable foaming test, sequence and electric-strength result.

gaps.normative_requirement: Humidity conditioning requires 48 h at specified humidity and a controlled temperature between 20 °C and 30 °C.
gaps.finding_reason: The report records 94% relative humidity but no actual cabinet temperature, conditioning temperature or measured duration; the printed preconditioning expression is incomplete.
gaps.required_action: Provide the humidity-conditioning record, including actual temperatures, duration and subsequent test results.

gaps.normative_requirement: Lid or door interlocks must withstand the specified endurance and resistance-to-forcing tests in the required sequence on the same appliance.
gaps.finding_reason: An interlock switch appears in the heating table, but the report does not address interlock endurance, forcing, test sequence or sample continuity.
gaps.required_action: Identify the interlock and document the applicable endurance and forcing tests on the required sample and in the required sequence.

gaps.normative_requirement: Motors are subject to applicable abnormal-operation tests, except motors driving moving parts of an oscillating agitator.
gaps.finding_reason: The report treats the appliance as motor-operated but marks the stalled-condition test N/A and leaves its results table empty without identifying the motor or establishing the exception.
gaps.required_action: Identify each motor and perform or justify exclusion from the applicable stalled-condition tests.

gaps.normative_requirement: An applicable series-motor test is performed at 1.3 times rated voltage for 1 min.
gaps.finding_reason: The report records 254.4 V and P; for the declared 240 V rating, 1.3 times rated voltage is 312 V.
gaps.required_action: Repeat the applicable series-motor test at 312 V for 1 min and record the outcome.

gaps.normative_requirement: Electronic circuits are evaluated for specified fault conditions unless the stated exemption conditions are met.
gaps.finding_reason: The report passes the electronic-circuit provision but marks the circuit fault evaluation N/A without a circuit description or an assessment supporting exemption.
gaps.required_action: Identify the electronic circuits and document the fault evaluation or a substantiated exemption.

gaps.normative_requirement: For washing machines with a programmer or timer, specified fault conditions are applied and the textile material shall not ignite, char or glow.
gaps.finding_reason: The report omits the particular-part fault conditions and textile acceptance criteria; the presence of a programmer or timer is not established.
gaps.required_action: Identify the controls and document the applicable washing-machine abnormal tests and textile observations.

gaps.normative_requirement: For the washing-machine stability test, doors and lids are closed and the appliance is empty or filled, whichever is more unfavourable.
gaps.finding_reason: The report passes a general-part statement requiring doors open or closed, whichever is more unfavourable, without recording the particular-part configuration.
gaps.required_action: Document or repeat the stability test with doors and lids closed and the specified loading condition.

gaps.normative_requirement: Applicable washing-machine requirements address unbalanced loads, interlocking and drum stopping or locking.
gaps.finding_reason: The report contains no particular-part mechanical-hazard assessment; drum type, loading direction, speed and energy are not identified to determine the relevant interlock and stopping tests.
gaps.required_action: Establish the machine construction and document the applicable unbalanced-load, interlock and stopping tests.

gaps.normative_requirement: Washing-machine lids and doors require adequate mechanical strength, and lids require resistance to distortion.
gaps.finding_reason: The report records general mechanical-strength tests but omits the particular lid and door tests; an interlock switch is recorded without identification of its associated closure.
gaps.required_action: Identify the lid or door and perform and document the applicable strength and distortion tests.

gaps.normative_requirement: Electrical insulation must be protected from condensation and leakage, subject to the particular-part ageing-test exception.
gaps.finding_reason: The report marks the construction requirement and leakage test N/A without identifying the water-containing construction or documenting an Annex BB ageing exemption.
gaps.required_action: Assess condensation and leakage paths and document the applicable inspection, test or ageing-test exemption.

gaps.normative_requirement: Applicable washing-machine construction provisions control opening of doors, hot-water filter compartments and mechanical emergency releases.
gaps.finding_reason: These particular-part provisions are absent, and the report does not identify whether the relevant door, filter compartment or release mechanism exists.
gaps.required_action: Describe these features and assess each applicable construction requirement.

gaps.normative_requirement: Required switches and applicable programmers and interlocks must meet the specified component endurance requirements.
gaps.finding_reason: A switch is listed as tested with the appliance and an interlock switch is recorded, but switch-cycle and washing-machine interlock or programmer endurance evidence is absent.
gaps.required_action: Identify the components and provide applicable component approvals or endurance-test results.

gaps.normative_requirement: Supply-cord inlet openings must permit introduction without damage and have the specified lining or bushing where applicable.
gaps.finding_reason: The appliance has a type Y supply cord, yet the inlet-opening requirement is marked N/A without a construction-based explanation.
gaps.required_action: Inspect and document the cord inlet and any required lining or bushing.

gaps.normative_requirement: For appliances with supply cords, current-carrying conductors must become taut before the earthing conductor if the cord slips.
gaps.finding_reason: The report declares a class I appliance with a type Y supply cord but marks this check N/A without justification.
gaps.required_action: Inspect the conductor arrangement and document the protective-earthing slack check.

gaps.normative_requirement: Electrical and earthing connections must maintain contact pressure despite applicable insulating-material shrinkage or distortion.
gaps.finding_reason: The report marks the requirement N/A even though it records electrical and earthing connections; no construction-based exemption is documented.
gaps.required_action: Inspect the electrical and earthing connections and document conformity or the applicable exemption.

gaps.normative_requirement: Creepage distances depend on working voltage, material group and pollution degree, with the particular washing-machine provisions applied.
gaps.finding_reason: The report reproduces the general pollution-degree rule and gives pass verdicts but no identifiable measured creepage paths or CTI evidence; functional creepage is marked N/A in the appended table.
gaps.required_action: Identify each insulation path, its measured distance, working voltage, CTI and applicable pollution degree or justified exception.

gaps.normative_requirement: Relevant non-metallic parts are checked for heat resistance by the specified ball-pressure test.
gaps.finding_reason: Clause 30.1 is marked P, but the appended ball-pressure table is N/A and contains no parts, test temperatures or impressions.
gaps.required_action: Provide the ball-pressure results for the relevant parts or document a valid exclusion for each.

gaps.normative_requirement: Where 30.2.3 applies, relevant non-metallic parts supporting or near connections are assessed at the specified glow-wire severities or by permitted alternatives.
gaps.finding_reason: The report passes the 850 °C and 750/650 °C provisions, but its only recorded glow-wire result is for the switch enclosure at 550 °C; connection current, exemption and material evidence are not supplied.
gaps.required_action: Document each relevant part and connection current and provide the required test results or qualifying material evidence.

gaps.normative_requirement: Required instructions must use an official language of the country of sale, and required markings must be legible, durable and on a main part.
gaps.finding_reason: Language and main-part marking are marked N/A; the marking entry concerns a hot-surface symbol rather than the required durability check.
gaps.required_action: Identify the destination and document the language, location, legibility and durability checks for required markings and instructions.

final_summary.evaluation_conclusion: The report does not establish compliance of model EC/27FW with the supplied general and washing-machine particular standards. In addition to the recorded heating failure, substantial washing-machine-specific evidence is absent or unsupported, including moisture, mechanical-hazard, interlock and abnormal-operation assessments.
final_summary.recommended_action: Resolve the sample identity and recorded failure, complete the applicable tests and issue an authenticated replacement report before certification proceeds.
